lines.t: In the beginning, He spoke light into the dark,
Formed us from the dust, breathed fire in our hearts.
Made for His glory, to walk in His ways,
We reached for the serpent and fell from His gaze.We hid in the shadows, we clothed ourselves in lies,
Built towers of pride that reached for the skies.
He sent us His prophets with tears in their cries,
We silenced their voices, we closed our own eyes.Holy and jealous, a consuming flame,
Burning with love, yet hating our shame.
He roars against all that rises in pride,
Yet pleads with the broken to run to His side.So He came down low, wore weakness and skin,
YahuShua, the Lamb, no shadow of sin.
Bore all our sorrows, our violence, our scars,
Blood like a river, poured under the stars.Wrath on rebellion, but mercy to fall,
On knees in the dust when we answer His call.
Hearts made of stone now shattered and healed,
His law in our bones, His love as our seal.Nations are raging, their idols on high,
Babylon laughing, her cup raised in pride.
Trumpets are shaking the kingdoms of men,
Still they choose darkness again and again.Yet over the thunder, a whisper of grace,
Arms ever open, a refuge, a place.
He gathers His remnant out of the flame,
Lifts up the lowly, brings down every name.Seals are all broken, the heavens grow red,
Books are flung open, all secrets are read.
Each hidden motive weighed in His hand,
Sheep to His pasture, chaff from the land.Fire on the ruins, the old world undone,
Night overthrown by the rise of the Son.
New earth and sky where tears flee away,
Love ever-present, an endless Day.So flee from the harlot, come out from her wine,
Cling to His covenant, cross over the line.
For He who formed you, who numbered your days,
Calls you from ashes into His blaze.Let every heartbeat bend low and agree,
“Yours is the kingdom; let Your will be.”
From first “Let there be” to last trumpet sound,
All of His story in mercy is bound.
